summary: You pick a subplan; its required courses (letter graded as each subplan says, ENGR communication courses may be pass/fail) count inside the 45 post-MS units. The audit checks those 45 units (all at the 100 level or above, at least 23 at 200 or above, at most 21 of thesis and research) and 90 graduate units. You move in the 45 units of master's depth, or have transfer credit approved, and check by hand the advisor's approval of your post-MS units (at most 6 CR/NC, at least 24 of lecture or lab classes), the 3.0 GPA, the candidacy application and the thesis.

E3fyA59C.why: "An ENG student admitted with no prior MS degree must complete 45 units of approved coursework to contribute toward the 90 unit residency requirement" and "A student who completed a degree equivalent to the CEE-MS at institution outside Stanford may request to receive up to 45 units of Graduate Residency Transfer Credit." Met by moving in the MS coursework or by the transfer credit.

AqM89S6h.why: "Separate from the master's depth, sudents must complete additional 45 units of unduplicated coursework and research to reach the required 90 units of graduate study ... All 45 units must be 100+ level, and at least 23 units must be 200+ level" (at most 22 units below 200) and "The remaining 21 units may include ... thesis units (e.g., CEE299, 300, 365A, 370A, 381)" (those named courses capped at 21 units). Advisor approval, the CR/NC cap and the 24 lecture or lab units are in ov-eng-checks.
